card.name: First digit in phone number groups
card.fires_on: A single digit at the start of a digit group inside a US phone number, such as the 2 in 651-228 or 207-287. It also fires on the 9 in a grade range like 9-12.

modes.label: Phone number groups
modes.description: The first digit of the exchange or area code in a phone number given as contact info.
modes.example: Dennis Lien can be reached at 651-<<2>>28-5588.

modes.label: Area code start
modes.description: The first digit inside parentheses or at the start of an area code.

modes.label: Grade range
modes.description: The starting number of a grade range written with a hyphen.
modes.example: invites Minnesota’s <<9>>-12 grade students to create art

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a number group in a phone number, such as the start of the area code or exchange.
evidence: Dennis Lien can be reached at 651-<<2>>28-5588.
